About.metaDescription: Who we are: FGV-SP's quantitative finance student league, founded in 2021. Math, statistics and programming applied to markets.
About.title: Math, statistics and code to understand markets
About.lead: FGV Quant is the quantitative finance student league at FGV-SP. Since {year}, about {members} members and trainees have studied, researched and built systematic strategies.

steps.title: Recruitment
steps.body: Every semester, at the start of FGV's academic term. No technical prerequisites.

steps.title: Trainee program
steps.body: Classes in statistics, econometrics, strategies, portfolios, fixed income, derivatives, programming and AI, with assessments and a final project.

steps.title: League member
steps.body: You choose an area (Academic, Research and Media, Institutional or Projects) and also take part in projects or competitions.

steps.title: The market
steps.body: Former members now work at banks and asset managers such as Goldman Sachs, Itaú Asset and Vinci Compass.

how.title: From theory to practice
how.description: A continuous cycle of study, research and market exposure.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Every semester, groups of members run research projects, with partner asset managers or on their own: they start from a paper or a market idea, model it in Python with mentoring and write the results up as papers.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.body: FGV Quant Insights, our monthly newsletter, brings together analysis, strategies and news from the field.

fund.title: Simulated fund
fund.body: FGV Quant Capital is a simulated, educational fund used to test strategies.

competitions.title: Challenges
competitions.body: League teams take part in quantitative finance and investment competitions.

events.title: Events
events.body: Meetups, talks and activities open to the community.

cta.title: Want to join the league?
cta.body: Follow the recruitment process and learn how to apply.

testimonials.title: In the words of those who came through the league
testimonials.description: Former members on how FGV Quant shaped them. Today they work at banks, asset managers and major financial institutions.
testimonials.pending: Testimonials will be published with each person's text and permission.
